sourceHints.description: Microservice modernization assessment: service identity, technology signals, integration surface, dependencies, risks, and recommended modernization path.

serviceName.description: Best inferred service or application name from repository metadata, build files, deployment descriptors, or README.

businessCapability.description: Business capability or domain responsibility inferred from naming, APIs, package structure, README, or configuration.

currentArchitecture.description: Short summary of the current architecture style, framework, and runtime model.

technologyStack.description: Detected languages, frameworks, runtimes, build tools, and relevant platform components.

integrationPoints.description: Detected inbound and outbound integrations such as REST, SOAP, queues, databases, external services, files, or scheduled jobs.

deploymentSignals.description: Deployment and runtime signals such as Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, cloud provider, CI/CD, environment variables, or platform-specific configuration.

modernizationDrivers.description: Reasons this service may need modernization, backed by evidence from code or configuration.

risks.description: Technical risks, migration risks, hidden coupling, missing documentation, obsolete dependencies, operational fragility, or test gaps.

recommendedPath.description: Recommended modernization path: rehost, replatform, refactor, rewrite, strangler, API facade, containerization, test characterization, or other path. Include the reasoning.
recommendedPath.default: Run deeper discovery before selecting a modernization path.

nextActions.description: Practical next actions for an engineering team to continue modernization discovery or implementation.
